name: poehelper
description: Windows desktop companion prototype for Path of Exile.
author: POEHelper contributors

scripts.build:capture-helper: dotnet publish native/capture-helper/POEHelper.CaptureHelper.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -p:PublishSingleFile=true -p:EnableCompressionInSingleFile=true -o native/capture-helper/publish/win-x64
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:capture-helper && electron-builder --win nsis portable --publish never
scripts.dist:win:portable: npm run build:capture-helper && electron-builder --win portable --publish never
scripts.dist:win:installer: npm run build:capture-helper && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
scripts.release:patch: npm run check && npm version patch -m "Release v%s" && git push --follow-tags && npm run release:win
scripts.release:win: npm run release:check && npm run release:ensure && npm run build:capture-helper && electron-builder --win nsis --publish always
